title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech-led profit-taking, defensives bid. Rotation out of AI/semis into staples, banks, and gold. The tape is a high-to-low churn with yields easing yet failing to lift Nasdaq, confirming narrow leadership is breaking.

INDICES — VIX 15.8, below 20-day MA of 15.9. DIA +0.27%, RSP +0.12%, SPY -0.29%, IWM -0.66%, QQQ -1.00%, SOXX -2.67%. Large > small by 0.08pp. Gold +0.79% vs oil -1.80% most notable cross-asset move.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio 0.96x avg, QQQ 0.96x avg — both near baseline. GLD at 2.0x and DIA at 1.2x seeing accumulation on gains; IWM and RSP fading to 0.7x/0.6x on losses = distribution. SOXX's -2.67% on low attention signals sellers exhausted near term.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLP Staples +1.70%, XLF Financials +1.29%, XLU Utilities +1.05%, XLC Comms +0.83%, XLRE Real Estate +0.55%, XLY Discretionary +0.24%, XLB Materials +0.07%, XLV Healthcare +0.05%, XLI Industrials -0.69%, XLE Energy -0.83%, XLK Technology -1.78%. Top: IBIT +2.20%, UNG +1.60%; Bottom: DRAM -5.89%, SOXX -2.67%. Money rotating out of AI hardware into staples, banks, utilities; label: AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — SPY put-call 1.01 elevated, QQQ 0.94 near neutral. Skew positive (SPY +5.9%, QQQ +10.4%) = put premium, fear intact. VIX 15.8 below 20-day 15.9 = complacency creeping. GLD skew -1.5% with put-call 0.51 — no fear in gold rally.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold +0.79% alongside dollar +0.22% breaks the inverse correlation — bid on tariff/geopolitical risk while oil -1.80% fades the same tensions. TLT +0.62% with banks XLF +1.29% shows bond easing lifting rate-sensitives, not growth.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 46.3 Neutral. Top movers: JBHT -5.65% on insider sale headline, NET -4.36% no catalyst—distribution on 20d momentum break, MP -4.38% despite rare-earth headline—profit-taking after surge. Vol spikes: IJT 9.1x at -0.33% distribution in small-cap style. Watch: SOXX -2.67% vol dry-up near 20d -1.95%—bounce risk; GLD +0.79% at 2.0x vol accumulation—trend accelerating; XLP +1.70% with 20d +2.45% momentum— rotation confirmation.
